# Chart controls references

`owner.json` freezes the light values, calmer dark values, final names and
Blue-Red stops from relay's committed owner records of 2026-10-26. Regenerate
with `freeze.py <decision-records.md> --elements data/elements/element-styles.tsv`.
The copied element table preserves the original Jmol and VESTA input colours
used by the 3D view; the 2D adjustment must not change that table.

The numerical observers use the independent published formulas already in
`approved_palettes/reference.py` and `palette_sources/oklab_reference.py`:

- WCAG relative luminance and contrast:
  https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-relative-luminance
- Ottosson's OKLab matrices, updated 2021-01-25:
  https://bottosson.github.io/posts/oklab/

Spacing expectations use the owner's closed form. The analytic scan fixtures
set the project's line-segment background to a constant 17 before any fit, so
subtraction has an independent pointwise expectation.

`probe.cpp` observes the actual core. Its optional figure-assignment branch
supports the shared public API while keeping the observer buildable against
the preceding API for red-first replay. It never supplies expected colours.

`replay.py <revision> <new-empty-directory>` exports committed core sources,
adds the current witnesses, and runs without a sibling product checkout with
CI and GITHUB_ACTIONS set. The colour-only core sources do not include or link
the crysta SDK. The runner needs the pinned Python environment's pytest and
NumPy, and a C++20 compiler. No reference is generated by edi itself.

The application witnesses require `build/app/app/edi_app_tests` from this
checkout, or `EDI_APP_TEST_RUNNER` naming an equivalent build. They exercise
the real Preferences, Graphs series, scan layer, project save/reopen, report
writer, saved HTML browser observer and PDF image observer. Their initial
runtime proof is pending this workspace's app build; unexecuted nodes remain
explicitly unmeasured in the runtime table. Formatting and collection do not
attest their runtime behaviour.
